categories.main_business_segments: Arrow Electronics operates two primary business segments: the Global Components segment, which distributes electronic components to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers (CMs), and the Global Enterprise Computing Solutions (ECS) segment, which provides enterprise computing solutions to value-added resellers (VARs) and managed service providers (MSPs). In 2022, approximately 78% of sales came from Global Components and 22% from Global ECS.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Arrow's core capabilities include the distribution of semiconductors, passive and electromechanical components, computing and memory products, and IT hardware/software. The company leverages value-added services such as design engineering, integration, global logistics, supply chain management, and digital platforms like ArrowSphere for cloud solutions. It aggregates products from multiple suppliers and provides demand creation, engineering support, and supply chain services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Arrow serves over 210,000 industrial and commercial customers worldwide, including OEMs, CMs, VARs, MSPs, and other commercial entities. Key end markets include industrial equipment, automotive, transportation, telecommunications, contract manufacturing, and consumer products, as well as IT infrastructure and cloud services for enterprise customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Arrow operates in over 90 countries, with significant presence in the Americas, Europe/Middle East/Africa (EMEA), and Asia/Pacific regions. In 2022, about 65% of sales were generated outside the United States, with major markets including the U.S., China/Hong Kong, and Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: Arrow operates primarily as a distributor (downstream) in the electronics and IT supply chain, acting as an intermediary between component and IT product manufacturers (suppliers) and end customers (OEMs, CMs, VARs, MSPs). The company also provides value-added supply chain services, including logistics, procurement, and inventory management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Arrow's strategic priorities include expanding value-added services, enhancing digital and cloud-based offerings (notably through ArrowSphere), and growing its supply chain solutions. The company focuses on accelerating customers' time to market, enabling secure and consistent supply chains, and driving innovation in areas such as industrial automation, edge computing, and smart/connected devices. Strategic acquisitions are pursued to broaden offerings and geographic reach.
categories.revenue_model: Arrow generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of electronic components, IT hardware, and software products. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, mostly on an order-by-order basis. The company also earns revenue from value-added services, supply chain solutions, and cloud marketplace subscriptions (ArrowSphere), with some agency-based transactions recognized on a net fee basis.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Arrow competes with large multinational and national distributors such as Avnet, CDW, TD Synnex, and WESCO, as well as specialized and regional players. The company is positioned as one of the world's largest and most diversified technology distributors, with a broad product portfolio, global reach, and extensive value-added services. Competition is based on price, product availability, service quality, and technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Arrow reported consolidated sales of $37.1 billion, up 7.7% from the prior year, with net income attributable to shareholders of $1.43 billion. The company has a global workforce of approximately 22,300 employees and maintains significant liquidity and working capital. Growth in 2022 was driven by strong demand in components and IT solutions, particularly in the Americas and EMEA, despite supply chain constraints and currency headwinds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Arrow differentiates itself through its comprehensive product and service portfolio, global distribution network, and deep technical expertise. The company emphasizes its ability to accelerate customers' innovation and time to market, provide secure and resilient supply chains, and deliver integrated solutions across electronics and IT. Its digital platforms and value-added services, such as engineering support and cloud marketplace, further enhance customer competitiveness and supplier reach.
